item.title: What Your Terminal Trusts
item.description:
On October 29, 2026, attackers moved $6.34 billion out of Binance wallets. The exchange later said $2.85 billion of that was frozen or intercepted. The FBI attributed the theft to North Korea. The part that matters for anyone who codes with an agent is how ordinary the start was.

This is the public account, compressed from Binance’s own writeup as reported by Ars Technica and WIRED. It is not a forensic report. I am not claiming the internal AI tool decided the attack, or that every keystroke was captured. Those details are not established.
